title: Change Lighthouse: Evals Dashboard + Integrated Alerting Orchestration
creator: Mariana Cortez
description:
Goal: Deliver an Evals-centred dashboard view in Console that links model/config change events to objective quality regressions and orchestrates downstream alerts (Slack/PagerDuty) with robust deduplication and suppression. The feature should make it easy for engineers and SREs to see which config or model rollouts correlate with eval metric shifts, reduce noisy PagerDuty pages, and provide clear remediation context (failing prompt sets, sample diffs, and rollout metadata).

Scope:
- A change-oriented Dashboard (Change Lighthouse) that surfaces eval-time series and highlights temporal correlation windows around model/config deploys.
- Alert orchestration that translates eval regressions into routed notifications: Slack channels for noisy/ongoing signals, PagerDuty for urgent/high-severity regressions, and an adaptive dedupe layer to avoid alert storms.
- Links from alerts to the exact rollout, PR, and failing eval examples.
- Configurable team-level policies for sensitivity, dedupe windows, and escalation rules.

Out of scope for initial launch: automated rollback/auto-mitigation, deep causal inference beyond basic temporal overlap heuristics, and full fidelity A/B traffic attribution (we'll rely on rollout metadata and start/end timestamps).
acceptance_criteria: Change Lighthouse dashboard exists in Console with a timeline view showing eval metric traces and annotated model/config rollout events
Dashboard displays top 5 affected evals for a change and includes links to failing examples and the rollout ID/PR
Alerting rules can be configured per-project: severity mapping (info/warn/critical), dedupe window (seconds/minutes/hours), and notification target (Slack channel, PagerDuty service)
Dedupe layer groups alerts for the same root cause (same rollout ID + same eval metric) within configured window and produces a single PagerDuty page for critical regressions
Slack notifications contain context payloads (metric delta, baseline, top failing prompts, link to dashboard) and include a unique fingerprint used for dedupe and followups
PagerDuty pages include runbook link, impacted customers (if any), and a direct link to Dashboard change details
Basic telemetry and SLOs: false positive rate monitored (sampling), alert delivery success >= 99%, and dashboards instrumented for latency and error rates
Integration tests exist that simulate a model/config change and verify a single grouped PagerDuty alert is produced when multiple eval signals trigger within the dedupe window
